description: Verify (or create) webhook signatures for Stripe, GitHub, Slack, Shopify, Twilio, Standard Webhooks / Svix, Paddle, Square, Zoom, Mailgun, Intercom, Linear, Typeform and HubSpot v3, or any generic HMAC scheme — the step agents get wrong when wiring up webhook receivers. Pass the raw body, the received headers (or just the signature) and the signing secret: returns valid, the timestamp age against a replay tolerance, and on failure a diagnosis (body re-serialised or trimmed, wrong secret format, hex vs base64, stale timestamp). mode=sign produces the exact headers a provider would send, for testing receivers. Constant-time comparison; the secret is never echoed. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/webhook-verify

id.description: Standard Webhooks / Svix message id when not in headers

payload.description: The raw request body exactly as received (not re-serialised JSON)

prefix.description: generic: prefix before the signature, e.g. "sha256="

signature.description: The signature header value (alternative to headers)

timestamp.description: Timestamp header value when not in headers (Slack, Zoom, Standard Webhooks, HubSpot)

tolerance.description: Max timestamp age in seconds (0 = skip)

name: webhook_verify
